sources.title: Apple Health
sources.from: The app reads HealthKit whenever it is open (Sources › Apple Health) — everything Health already holds on the first sync, then the last few days on every launch
sources.storage: observations table in data/life.db (SQLite, append-only): one row per metric per day (steps, distance, energy, exercise, heart rate, resting HR, HRV, VO2max, weight, body fat), one per night of sleep, one per workout

kinds.note: one row per day — the day's total
